definitions.gloss: developed country; advanced nation; industrialized country
definitions.explanation: A country with a highly developed economy, advanced technology, and high standard of living. Commonly used in news, politics, and economics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先進国|せんしんこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan is one of the developed countries.

examples.japanese: {先進国|せんしんこく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}する→存在する：17185_sonzaisuru⟧。
examples.english: Poverty issues exist even in developed countries.

examples.japanese: G7⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{先進国|せんしんこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧だ。
examples.english: The G7 is a summit where the leaders of the major developed nations gather.

notes:
The opposite term is ⟦{途上国|とじょうこく}→途上国：14424_tojoukoku⟧ (developing country) or ⟦{発展途上国|はってんとじょうこく}→発展途上国：22732_hattentojoukoku⟧ (developing nation). {先進国|せんしんこく} is the standard neutral term in Japanese media and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{先進国|せんしんこく} — major developed nations
- {先進国|せんしんこく}⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ — summit of advanced nations
- {先進国|せんしんこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{途上国|とじょうこく}→途上国：14424_tojoukoku⟧ — developed and developing countries
- {先進国|せんしんこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — among developed nations
